remarks: Welcome home to this updated multi-level condo in the heart of Norwalk. Featuring modern finishes throughout, this spacious unit offers an open layout with vaulted ceilings, wood-style flooring, and abundant natural light. The kitchen has been refreshed with white shaker cabinetry, sleek hardware, and stainless appliances. Bathrooms feature clean tilework and stylish black fixtures for a contemporary look. A shared balcony provides outdoor space for relaxing or morning coffee, and the top-floor loft adds flexible living or work-from-home potential.  Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, central air, and garage parking directly below your unit. Located minutes from Norwalk's best amenities-including the SoNo Collection, Calf Pasture Beach, and the lively dining scene along Washington Street-you'll have easy access to shopping, parks, and I-95 for commuting.
